content.title: The Virgin Birth of Christ
content.author: J. Gresham Machen (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1930)
content.note: The classic Presbyterian defence of the virgin birth: the birth narratives' Palestinian character, the second-century witness and the alternative theories. Published 1930, so in the US public domain from 1 January 2026; Machen died in 1937. No copy is held (the Internet Archive copies are lending only), so it is described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted.
